{"metadata":{"description":"A native DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin bridging dsh coding agents to Feishu/Lark group chats — one group, one project directory.","id":"gh:1339469423","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"lark-agent-bridge","slug":"bihangchi9-creator/lark-agent-bridge","topics":["bot","coding-agent","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","feishu","lark"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A native DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin bridging dsh coding agents to Feishu/Lark group chats — one g"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"roup, one project directory."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Lark Agent Bridge"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"npm package: `@bihangchi9/lark-agent-bridge` · git repo: `lark-agent-bridge`"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> A Feishu / Lark bridge for local coding agents — *one group, one conversation, one pinned runtime*"},{"id":"p4s2","text":". Bridges **dsh** (in-process plugin), **CLI** agents (`traex` / `codex`, spawned by a daemon), an *"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"*IDE** window (attached over a socket), or a **custom** agent — behind one gateway."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"中文 README"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Send a message in a Feishu chat, and a real coding agent — with its own tools, its own project direc"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"tory, and its own persistent conversation — answers you right there. Each group chat is an isolated "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"workspace pinned to exactly one runtime, so a team can run several projects (and several agents) in "},{"id":"p6s4","text":"parallel, one per group."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Feishu ⇄ your agent.** Inbound Feishu messages drive a live agent; the reply streams back onto a"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" live-updating Feishu message. The agent is whichever runtime this chat is pinned to (dsh / CLI / ID"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"E / custom).
- **Four host classes, one contract.** Every runtime implements the same `AgentAdapter`"},{"id":"p8s4","text":": dsh runs in-process as a plugin; CLI **spawns** `traex`/`codex`; IDE **attaches** a running window"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"; custom loads your own module. They never silently replace each other.
- **One group, one conversat"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"ion, one pinned runtime.** Every chat id maps to a stable directory (`<workspaceRoot>/<chatId>`) and"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" one runtime chosen with `/agent`. Different groups never touch each other's files, and a message is"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" never broadcast to several agents. If the pinned runtime is down (e.g. an IDE window closed), that "},{"id":"p8s9","text":"chat fails closed instead of retargeting.
- **Persistent per-chat sessions.** A chat's conversation "},{"id":"p8s10","text":"survives restarts (policy-fingerprint-gated resume-or-create; `/new` really clears it).
- **Files an"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"d images.** Send them to the bot and the bridge stores each message in an isolated `.attachments/<me"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"ssageId>/` folder, then gives the paths to the agent. Limits: 5 attachments per message, images ≤10 "},{"id":"p8s13","text":"MB, other files ≤20 MB; names are sanitized and stale files are swept after 7 days. Whether an image"},{"id":"p8s14","text":" can actually be interpreted depends on the selected model's vision support.
- **Zero-config setup.*"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"* On first launch, if no credentials exist, a QR registration wizard runs — scan it in the Feishu ap"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"p and it connects automatically. No portal spelunking.
- **Slash commands.** `/help`, `/new`, `/wher"},{"id":"p8s17","text":"e`, `/models`, `/agent`, and `/whoami` manage each chat locally; owner-only `/agent`, `/model`, `/pr"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"eset`, `/allow`, and `/disallow` change shared chat state. `/agent` pins this chat to one installed "},{"id":"p8s19","text":"runtime and never silently retargets."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Architecture in one picture"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The bot **registration lives entirely on Feishu**. The gateway connects out to Feishu over a long-li"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"ved WebSocket (so no public IP or callback URL is needed). For **dsh** the gateway *is* the plugin l"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"oaded by `dsh web`; for **CLI / IDE / custom** it is a **separate daemon** (`node lib/daemon.js`), i"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ndependent of any dsh host."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"CLI **spawns** the binary. IDE **attaches** a Unix-socket JSONL sidecar owned by the current user an"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"d not writable by group/others (`chmod 600 /path/to.sock`; window closed ⇒ that line dies). Custom l"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"oads an `AgentAdapter` module (see `examples/custom-adapter.mjs`). One group is still one conversati"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"on pinned with `/agent`; a dead line is not retargeted."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"ByteDance-only overlay (SSO, bytecli, extra presets) lives in a local `internal/` directory that is "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"gitignored. - A **DeepSeek API key** (set `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, or configure it in your dsh crede"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"ntials).
